headline: Fed projected to potentially cut rates a third time; near-term September hike odds at 66%
summary: While some longer-term projections see the Fed cutting rates further, the near-term September 2026 picture shows markets pricing a 66% probability of a rate hike at the September FOMC meeting, with the Fed currently at 3.50-3.75%. The hawkish tilt is driven by oil-price inflation from the Iran war.
key_facts: Fed funds target: 3.50–3.75% (as of July 29 FOMC)
Markets pricing ~66% probability of 25 bps hike in September
Hawkish pressure from oil-driven inflation (Brent $95/bbl)
December 2025 projections had Fed cutting only 50 bps total in 2026–2027
